Single continuous first-person eye-level shot of the same seated receiving clerk at the supplied desk, preserving identity, clothes and setting. Hands remain resting. No exchange, signing, writing or new object. No player face, body, reflection or over-the-shoulder view. No captions, writing, titles, labels, cards, lists, tables, screen text, blur patches, masks, mosaic or overlays. Real paper props must stay unmarked or seen obliquely out of focus through natural photography; do not add postproduction panels.

SPOKEN DIALOGUE WHITELIST. Voice identity is the one on-screen adult male; calm natural Mandarin. Speak only the exact quoted utterance, beginning after 0.4 seconds and finishing by 10.5 seconds. Only this visible man owns its lip movement.
Allowed utterance 1: "兴复汉室是他许下的诺言。他也担心，蜀汉守着这一隅，究竟能撑多久。"
All labels, identities, speaker names outside the quoted utterance, narration tags, timestamps and instructions are control information and must never be spoken. Add no words and no voice-over. No other voice. No BGM, no background music, no score, no singing or musical rhythm. Only soft location ambience and action-synchronous natural sound.
